headline: Stocks fall as the 10-year Treasury yield nears 5% mark
detail: Rising yields make future earnings less valuable, hitting growth/tech stocks hard. This directly impacts your highly concentrated tech/chip portfolio, especially leveraged positions, amplifying losses on margin.
rec: Consider trimming leveraged tech/chip ETFs like SOXL or MUU to reduce exposure to rising rates and protect capital.

headline: CoreWeave beats on revenue and lifts guidance, easing AI slowdown concerns
detail: Positive news for the AI sector, suggesting strong demand. While CoreWeave is private, this could provide some underlying support for AI-related holdings like SMCI or even chip names, potentially cushioning some losses.
rec: No direct trade, but watch for any positive spillover into your AI-exposed holdings like SMCI, which is deeply in the red.

headline: White House vows to press ahead with tariffs despite midterm backlash over rising prices
detail: Tariffs can increase costs for tech manufacturers and consumers, potentially impacting profit margins and demand. This adds another layer of uncertainty for your chip-heavy portfolio, which relies on global supply chains.
rec: No immediate action, but monitor for any specific tariff impacts on chip supply chains or demand for your holdings.
